claim_ceiling: TF-IDF 174k formal suite correctly executed; benchmarks honestly report 5-9 FAILs per representation. Protocol-level threshold weaknesses (boilerplate corr>0.1, zoom>0, cross_lang>0) noted but not execution defects.
evidence_summary: Verified 8 TF-IDF representations against 12 frozen benchmarks (config hash 4323f833fa72366a). All metrics recompute within FP precision. No leakage (frozen subsamples seed=42, frozen citation pairs). Boilerplate benchmark threshold (corr>0.1) permits boilerplate-dominated reps to PASS (corr up to 0.914) — adversarial_falsification correctly FAILs these (lang_dom~0.998). Hierarchy_coherence (purity>0.7, NMI>0.3) and legal_area_clustering (purity>0.5) FAIL universally — valid negative result. Citation_heritage AUC 0.96-0.97 for citation-based reps but structural benchmarks FAIL — correctly exposes citation-vs-structure tradeoff. Temporal_stability FAILs for citation reps (std 0.15-0.18), PASS for full-text (std~0.0003). No benchmark gaming, selective reporting, or metric hacking detected.
